Transpile all TypeScript files under inputDir to JavaScript into outputDir.
Used by the CLI build to finalize the .swiss-temp output.

Package that exports createElement, Fragment, and Signal.
Defaults to the framework's own core package but can be set to any
package that satisfies the same interface (e.g. a fork or re-export).

Parse a SwissJS template (JSX content from a render method or .uix file)
into a TemplateAST.

The source may be the full content of a .ui/.uix file, or just the JSX
portion extracted from a render() method body. The parser does not
transform the source — that is the compiler pipeline's responsibility.
